reviews.rationale: The agent correctly recognized that the provided data (void fraction of joints) fundamentally mismatched the assigned business problem (cylinder bore roughness of a honing line). However, instead of halting substantive analysis, the agent proceeded to evaluate stability and capability on the mismatched data and presented these as conclusive findings to the business (e.g., claiming 'There is no quality emergency here'). Advancing an irrelevant dataset as the solution to a specific business request is a critical failure that could severely mislead stakeholders. Furthermore, the agent contradicted its own nonnormal capability model (which established a 99.865th percentile of 20.86) by recommending a normal-theory I-MR chart for ongoing control with an upper limit of 17.21. This ensures that normal common-cause right-tail variation will repeatedly trigger false alarms.
